name: aMule
description: aMule is a peer-to-peer file sharing client for the eD2k and Kad networks. It runs headless as a daemon and is controlled from a web UI, the amulecmd command line, or a remote aMule GUI.

notes.text: The web UI password is AMULE_WEB_PASSWORD in /opt/amule_data/.env inside the container.
For a HighID, forward 4662/tcp, 4665/udp and 4672/udp from your router to the container. Without it you get a LowID and slower downloads.
Downloads go to /opt/amule_data/Incoming and unfinished files to /opt/amule_data/Temp. To keep them on another storage, add Proxmox mount points at those two paths.
